# TailgateTime

TailgateTime helps hosts and fans organize and find private, free, and paid tailgates.

- [Pricing](https://tailgate-time.com/pricing): Standard paid-event fee, processing, payouts and refunds.
- [Features](https://tailgate-time.com/features): Guest lists, check-in, messages, payouts and Host Pages.
- [Communities](https://tailgate-time.com/customers): Featured partners and public listings.
- [Discover](https://tailgate-time.com/discover): Public events. Private invitations are not public listings.
- [Terms](https://tailgate-time.com/terms): Refund and payout policies.
